message: Added a simple Privacy & Data Notice explaining local storage, access, export/delete controls, and that DuitKu is not a bank or e-wallet.
fixes: Added Privacy & Data Notice for normal users in Profile
Explains what data is stored: account, expenses, wallets, salary/income, budgets, settings, backups, patch status, and biometric reference
Explains data is stored locally in the browser/device using local storage
Explains who can access it and how users can export, backup, restore, or delete their data
Clarifies DuitKu Beta is not a bank, e-wallet, payment service, or financial institution

changelog.title: Privacy & Data Notice
fixes: Added simple Privacy & Data Notice for all users
Explains what data is stored and where it is stored
Explains export, backup, restore, and delete controls
Clarifies DuitKu Beta is not a bank or e-wallet

changelog.title: Beta version notes for all users
fixes: Added App Updates section in Profile
Normal users can see current version, latest version, and fix history
Added visible Beta label for DuitKu
Update banner is now visible to normal users

changelog.title: Biometric login fix
fixes: Tapping an account starts biometric login immediately
Biometric button resets after failed or cancelled attempt
Improved WebAuthn compatibility on phones

changelog.title: Developer passcode protection
fixes: Added developer passcode before showing patch tools
Developer tools are hidden from normal users

changelog.title: Developer patch system
fixes: Added version check using /patch/version.json
Added safe backup before refresh
Added service worker cache refresh support
